paragraphs: In Eruvin 58a, R' Nachman said, “Such as the town of Natuzai.” Rashi explains: the town of that man.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Supplied נתוזאי differs from older machine נתזואי. The name remains provisionally transliterated without identifying a person or a town beyond Hyman’s report.

אר״נ is read contextually as Nachman said, with title component R', without exact full-title evidence. דיסקרתא is glossed town and Rashi’s כרך as town/city; the attribution to Rashi remains explicit. נח. gives Eruvin 58a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
